notes: All 12 views inspected. Wooden mantel clock with a swept arched case, moulded base, brass bezel and a cream dial with minute track and two hands. A zoomed crop of the dial confirms tick marks and hands only, with no maker's name. Rear views show a finished back panel with a winding hole rather than an open cavity, and the base is fully closed.
limitations: Not rigged in the shipped glTF; the hands cannot be driven without re-parenting them.
The dial is a texture, so the displayed time cannot be changed without editing the texture.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
